blocks.zh: 第一章：監測方法 — 空氣、表面與人員取樣
blocks.en: Chapter 1: Monitoring Methods - Air, Surface and Personnel Sampling

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 認識各類主動式空氣取樣器（STA, Sieve Impactor, Centrifugal, SAS, Gelatin Filter）的工作原理與適用場景
blocks.en: Understand the working principles and typical applications of the active air samplers (STA, sieve impactor, centrifugal, SAS, gelatin filter)

blocks.zh: 理解被動式沉降板（Settle Plates）的角色、暴露時間建議（4–5 小時），以及為何在 ISO 5 環境中可能更適用
blocks.en: Understand the role of passive settling plates, the recommended exposure time (4–5 hours), and why they may be more suitable in ISO 5 environments

blocks.zh: 掌握表面取樣方法（Contact Plates, Swabs）的標準化現狀與回收率限制（<50%）
blocks.en: Know the current state of standardization of surface sampling methods (contact plates, swabs) and their recovery limitation (<50%)

blocks.zh: 認識人員監測（手套、衣著）的時機與注意事項
blocks.en: Know when and how to monitor personnel (gloves, garments) and the points to watch

blocks.zh: 理解取樣體積需求（至少 1 立方米空氣）與遠端取樣系統的考量
blocks.en: Understand the sample volume requirement (at least 1 cubic meter of air) and the considerations for remote sampling systems

blocks.zh: Sampling Airborne Microorganisms — 空氣微生物取樣
blocks.en: Sampling Airborne Microorganisms

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：主動式空氣取樣器分類
blocks.en: Core Concept: Classification of Active Air Samplers

blocks.zh: USP 列出六種主動式空氣取樣器，可以依照「收集原理」分為三大類：
blocks.en: USP lists six types of active air samplers, which can be grouped into three categories by collection principle:

blocks.zh: 衝擊式（Impaction） — STA、Sieve Impactor、SAS：利用慣性將微生物衝擊到培養基表面
blocks.en: Impaction - STA, sieve impactor, SAS: use inertia to impact microorganisms onto the surface of the culture medium

blocks.zh: 離心式（Centrifugal） — Centrifugal Sampler：利用離心力將微粒甩向培養基
blocks.en: Centrifugal - centrifugal sampler: uses centrifugal force to throw particles onto the culture medium

blocks.zh: 過濾式（Filtration） — Gelatin Filter：將空氣通過明膠濾膜捕捉微生物
blocks.en: Filtration - gelatin filter: passes air through a gelatin membrane filter to capture microorganisms

blocks.zh: 每種方法的回收效率不同，USP 特別強調「不應假設不同方法取相同體積的空氣會產生相似的回收率」。這對 CDMO 的 method validation 有重大意義。
blocks.en: Each method has a different recovery efficiency, and USP specifically stresses that "one should not assume that different methods sampling the same volume of air will give similar recovery rates." This has major implications for method validation in a CDMO.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：捕魚的不同方法
blocks.en: Analogy: Different Ways of Catching Fish

blocks.zh: 想像你要估算一條河裡有多少魚。你可以用刺網（衝擊式 — 魚撞上去被捕獲）、旋轉水車（離心式 — 水流帶魚到收集區）、或篩網（過濾式 — 水通過但魚留下來）。
blocks.en: Imagine you want to estimate how many fish are in a river. You could use a gill net (impaction: fish hit the net and are caught), a rotating water wheel (centrifugal: the current carries fish to a collection area), or a sieve (filtration: water passes through but the fish stay behind).

blocks.zh: 每種方法能捕到的魚種和數量不同 — 大魚容易被刺網捕到，小魚可能從刺網的洞逃走但被篩網攔住。所以用不同方法得到的「魚數」不能直接比較。空氣取樣也一樣：不同型號的取樣器對同一環境給出的 cfu 數據可能相差 5–10 倍。
blocks.en: Each method catches different species and numbers of fish. Big fish are easily caught in a gill net, while small fish may slip through its holes but be stopped by a sieve. So the "fish counts" from different methods cannot be compared directly. The same is true of air sampling: different sampler models can give cfu results that differ by 5–10 times for the same environment.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 實務選型考量
blocks.en: Key Point: Sampler Selection Considerations in CDMO Practice

blocks.zh: STA（Slit-to-Agar）：可提供時間分辨資訊（旋轉盤），適合追蹤汙染事件的時間點，但體積大不適合 Isolator 內部
blocks.en: STA (slit-to-agar): provides time-resolved information (rotating plate), which is useful for pinpointing when a contamination event occurred, but it is bulky and not suitable for use inside an isolator

blocks.zh: Sieve Impactor（如 Andersen sampler）：最常見的製藥環境取樣器，一次取樣 1 m³ 約需 15 分鐘（80 L/min）
blocks.en: Sieve impactor (e.g., Andersen sampler): the most common sampler in pharmaceutical environments; sampling 1 m³ takes about 15 minutes (80 L/min)

blocks.zh: SAS：輕便、可手持，適合快速巡邏式取樣
blocks.en: SAS: lightweight and handheld, suited to quick walk-around sampling

blocks.zh: Gelatin Filter：最大優勢是可遠端取樣，探頭放在 ISO 5 區域，設備主體在外面 — 減少人員介入
blocks.en: Gelatin filter: its biggest advantage is remote sampling, with the probe placed in the ISO 5 area and the main unit outside, which reduces personnel intervention

blocks.zh: Cross-reference：EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) Section 9.25 要求 active air sampling「至少 1 m³」，與 USP 〈1116〉 的建議一致。
blocks.en: Cross-reference: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) Section 9.25 requires active air sampling of "at least 1 m³", consistent with the recommendation in USP <1116>.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在評估兩家不同品牌的 sieve impactor。為什麼 USP 強調不同設備取相同體積的空氣可能得到不同結果？這對你的 Method Validation Protocol 有什麼啟示？
blocks.en: Your CDMO is evaluating two different brands of sieve impactor. Why does USP stress that different devices sampling the same volume of air may give different results? What does this imply for your method validation protocol?

blocks.zh: 在一條 Isolator 充填線中，你會選擇哪種空氣取樣器？為什麼？
blocks.en: On an isolator filling line, which type of air sampler would you choose, and why?

blocks.zh: Settling Plates — 沉降板
blocks.en: Settling Plates

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Settle Plates 的獨特價值
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Unique Value of Settle Plates

blocks.zh: 沉降板（Settle Plates）是最古老也最簡單的空氣微生物取樣方法，但 USP 特別指出它有一個關鍵優勢：
blocks.en: Settle plates are the oldest and simplest method of sampling airborne microorganisms, but USP points out a key advantage:

blocks.zh: 非侵入性 — 不需要設備、不需要電源、不會干擾氣流
blocks.en: Non-intrusive - no equipment or power is needed, and airflow is not disturbed

blocks.zh: 長時間暴露 — 4–5 小時的連續監測，增加偵測低濃度汙染的機會
blocks.en: Long exposure - continuous monitoring for 4–5 hours increases the chance of detecting low-level contamination

blocks.zh: 在 ISO 5 critical zone 特別適用 — 因為主動式取樣器在此區域可能造成更多問題
blocks.en: Especially suitable in the ISO 5 critical zone - because active samplers may cause more problems in this area

blocks.zh: Cross-reference：EU GMP Annex 1 Table 7 規定 Grade A 的 settle plate limit 為 <1 cfu/4 hours。這個 4 小時暴露時間與 USP 的建議完全吻合。
blocks.en: Cross-reference: EU GMP Annex 1 Table 7 sets the settle plate limit for Grade A at <1 cfu/4 hours. This 4-hour exposure time matches the USP recommendation exactly.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：路口的測速方式
blocks.en: Analogy: Ways of Checking Speed at an Intersection

blocks.zh: 主動式空氣取樣器就像交通警察用測速槍 — 精確但需要人員在場操作，而且每次只能測一瞬間。沉降板則像路口的固定式攝影機 — 雖然不如測速槍「精準」，但它 24 小時不間斷地記錄，更容易捕捉到偶發的超速車輛。
blocks.en: An active air sampler is like a traffic officer with a radar gun: accurate, but it needs a person present to operate it, and it measures only a single moment each time. A settling plate is like a fixed camera at the intersection: less "precise" than the radar gun, but it records 24 hours a day without interruption, so it is more likely to catch an occasional speeding car.

blocks.zh: 在微生物極少的 ISO 5 環境中，「長時間持續觀察」比「短時間精確測量」更有價值 — 因為汙染事件本身就極為罕見。
blocks.en: In an ISO 5 environment where microorganisms are extremely scarce, "long continuous observation" is more valuable than "brief precise measurement", because contamination events are themselves very rare.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：取樣體積的關鍵要求
blocks.en: Key Point: The Key Requirement on Sample Volume

blocks.zh: USP 建議至少取 1 m³ 空氣（1000 L），這是一個非常重要的實務標準：
blocks.en: USP recommends sampling at least 1 m³ of air (1000 L), which is a very important practical standard:

blocks.zh: 以 80 L/min 的典型流速計算 → 需要 12.5 分鐘
blocks.en: At a typical flow rate of 80 L/min, this takes 12.5 minutes

blocks.zh: USP 建議可能需要超過 15 分鐘的取樣時間
blocks.en: USP notes that a sampling time of more than 15 minutes may be needed

blocks.zh: 但必須同時考慮取樣器對氣流的干擾
blocks.en: But the disturbance the sampler causes to airflow must also be considered

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，這意味著你的 EM SOP 需要明確定義取樣體積和時間，並在 method validation 中證明選定的組合能提供足夠的靈敏度。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, this means your EM SOP must clearly define the sample volume and time, and your method validation must show that the chosen combination provides sufficient sensitivity.

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠員發現你的 ISO 5 主動空氣取樣只取 200 L（約 2.5 分鐘）。引用 USP 〈1116〉 的建議，這樣的取樣量是否足夠？你會如何辯護或改善？
blocks.en: An FDA investigator finds that your ISO 5 active air sampling takes only 200 L (about 2.5 minutes). Citing the recommendations of USP <1116>, is this sample volume sufficient? How would you defend or improve it?

blocks.zh: 你的客戶要求在充填過程中不使用沉降板（擔心板子掉入產品）。你會如何平衡監測需求和產品安全？
blocks.en: Your client asks that settling plates not be used during filling (for fear that a plate could fall into the product). How would you balance monitoring needs and product safety?

blocks.zh: Surface Sampling — 表面取樣
blocks.en: Surface Sampling

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：蓋章 vs 擦拭
blocks.en: Analogy: Stamping vs. Wiping

blocks.zh: Contact plate 就像在桌面上「蓋印章」— 把培養基直接壓在表面上，表面的微生物就會轉移到培養基上。簡單快速，但只能用在平坦表面。
blocks.en: A contact plate is like "stamping" a table surface: the culture medium is pressed directly onto the surface and the microorganisms on it transfer to the medium. It is simple and quick, but can only be used on flat surfaces.

blocks.zh: Swab 則像用濕抹布「擦拭」— 可以擦到角落和縫隙，但擦完後還需要把抹布上的東西洗下來才能計數。多了一步轉移，就多了一層不確定性。
blocks.en: A swab is like "wiping" with a damp cloth: it can reach corners and crevices, but afterwards the material on the cloth must be washed off before it can be counted. The extra transfer step adds a layer of uncertainty.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Product Contact Surface 只能在生產結束後取樣
blocks.en: Key Point: Product Contact Surfaces Should Be Sampled Only After Production Ends

blocks.zh: 這是一個在 FDA 查廠中經常被關注的重點：
blocks.en: This is a point that is often examined during FDA inspections:

blocks.zh: 在生產過程中對產品接觸面取樣 → 可能引入汙染（取樣人員、取樣器材、培養基殘留）
blocks.en: Sampling a product contact surface during production may introduce contamination (from the sampler, the sampling equipment, or culture medium residue)

blocks.zh: 培養基或稀釋液的殘留可能促進微生物在表面增殖
blocks.en: Residue of culture medium or diluent may promote microbial growth on the surface

blocks.zh: 清潔殘留物需要額外的人員介入和動作 → 更多汙染風險
blocks.en: Cleaning off residues requires additional personnel intervention and actions, which means more contamination risk

blocks.zh: 表面取樣結果不能作為產品放行或拒收的依據
blocks.en: Surface sampling results cannot be used as the basis for releasing or rejecting a product

blocks.zh: Cross-reference：EU GMP Annex 1 Section 9.30 要求 Grade A 表面監測在「操作結束後」進行，與 USP 完全一致。PDA TR13 也有詳細的取樣時機指導。
blocks.en: Cross-reference: EU GMP Annex 1 Section 9.30 requires Grade A surface monitoring to be performed "at the end of the operation", fully consistent with USP. PDA TR13 also gives detailed guidance on sampling timing.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 有一台充填機的產品接觸面有許多不規則凹槽。Contact plate 無法有效取樣。你會如何設計 swabbing protocol？需要定義哪些參數？
blocks.en: A filling machine at your CDMO has product contact surfaces with many irregular grooves, and contact plates cannot sample them effectively. How would you design the swabbing protocol? Which parameters need to be defined?

blocks.zh: 一位 QA 同事主張「如果表面取樣發現汙染，就應該拒收當批產品」。引用 USP 〈1116〉，你會如何回應？
blocks.en: A QA colleague argues that "if surface sampling finds contamination, the batch should be rejected." Citing USP <1116>, how would you respond?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：兩種表面取樣方法
blocks.en: Core Concept: Two Surface Sampling Methods

blocks.zh: USP 描述了兩種互補的表面取樣方法：
blocks.en: USP describes two complementary surface sampling methods:

blocks.zh: Culture Media, Diluents & Microbial Identification — 培養基、稀釋液與微生物鑑定
blocks.en: Culture Media, Diluents & Microbial Identification

blocks.zh: 核心概念：微生物鑑定的分層策略
blocks.en: Core Concept: A Tiered Strategy for Microbial Identification

blocks.zh: USP 建議一個基於風險的鑑定優先順序：
blocks.en: USP recommends a risk-based priority for identification:

blocks.zh: 最高優先 — ISO 5 critical zone 和鄰近區域的分離株 → 必須鑑定到種（species level）
blocks.en: Highest priority - isolates from the ISO 5 critical zone and adjacent areas: must be identified to species level

blocks.zh: 次要優先 — 支持區域（ISO 7/8）的分離株 → 至少鑑定到屬（genus level）
blocks.en: Second priority - isolates from support areas (ISO 7/8): identified to at least genus level

blocks.zh: 最低優先 — 非關鍵區域的分離株 → 根據調查需要決定是否鑑定
blocks.en: Lowest priority - isolates from non-critical areas: identification is decided by the needs of the investigation

blocks.zh: 這個分層策略在資源有限的 CDMO 環境中尤其重要 — 不是所有的菌落都需要同等深度的鑑定。
blocks.en: This tiered strategy is especially important in a resource-limited CDMO environment: not every colony needs the same depth of identification.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：犯罪現場的指紋處理
blocks.en: Analogy: Handling Fingerprints at a Crime Scene

blocks.zh: 微生物鑑定就像犯罪現場的指紋分析。在銀行金庫（ISO 5）發現的每一個指紋都必須詳細比對 — 因為那是高風險區域。但在銀行大廳（ISO 7/8）的指紋，你可能只需要確認「是不是自己人的」。至於銀行外面人行道（非分級區域）的指紋，除非有特殊案件需要，通常不需要分析。
blocks.en: Microbial identification is like fingerprint analysis at a crime scene. Every fingerprint found in the bank vault (ISO 5) must be matched in detail, because it is a high-risk area. For fingerprints in the bank lobby (ISO 7/8), you may only need to confirm whether they belong to "our own people". Fingerprints on the sidewalk outside the bank (unclassified areas) usually need no analysis unless a particular case requires it.

blocks.zh: 建立「環境菌群庫」（facility flora library）就像建立一個「員工指紋資料庫」— 當新指紋出現時，你可以立刻知道這是不是預期的菌種。
blocks.en: Building a "facility flora library" is like building a "staff fingerprint database": when a new fingerprint appears, you can immediately tell whether it is an expected organism.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：FDA 查廠焦點 — 環境菌群趨勢
blocks.en: Key Point: FDA Inspection Focus - Environmental Flora Trends

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠員在審查 EM 計畫時，特別關注以下問題：
blocks.en: When reviewing an EM program, FDA investigators pay particular attention to the following questions:

blocks.zh: 你有沒有建立 facility-specific 的「正常菌群」清單？
blocks.en: Have you established a facility-specific list of "normal flora"?

blocks.zh: 當出現不在正常清單上的菌種時，你的調查程序是什麼？
blocks.en: When an organism that is not on the normal list appears, what is your investigation procedure?

blocks.zh: 特別關注 objectionable organisms（如 Staphylococcus aureus, Pseudomonas spp., Burkholderia cepacia）的出現
blocks.en: Special attention to the appearance of objectionable organisms (such as Staphylococcus aureus, Pseudomonas spp., Burkholderia cepacia)

blocks.zh: 微生物鑑定方法（如 16S rRNA, MALDI-TOF, Vitek）是否經過驗證？
blocks.en: Have the microbial identification methods (such as 16S rRNA, MALDI-TOF, Vitek) been validated?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 在 ISO 5 區域發現一株 Bacillus species。這個發現的意義是什麼？它通常的來源是什麼？你會展開什麼樣的調查？
blocks.en: Your CDMO finds a Bacillus species in an ISO 5 area. What is the significance of this finding? What is its usual source? What kind of investigation would you launch?

blocks.zh: 你正在評估是否引進 MALDI-TOF 微生物鑑定系統。與傳統生化鑑定相比，它的主要優勢和限制分別是什麼？
blocks.en: You are evaluating whether to introduce a MALDI-TOF microbial identification system. Compared with traditional biochemical identification, what are its main advantages and limitations?
